mutations.name: schema meta-validation error
mutations.old: R.error("E-SCHEMA-META", f"{name}.schema.json", exc.message)

mutations.name: schema $id equals file name
mutations.old: R.check(s.get("$id") == f"{name}.schema.json", "E-SCHEMA-ID", f"{name}.schema.json", f"$id {s.get('$id')!r} must equal the file name")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-SCHEMA-ID", f"{name}.schema.json", f"$id {s.get('$id')!r} must equal the file name")

mutations.name: schema draft 2020-12
mutations.old: R.check(s.get("$schema") == "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "E-SCHEMA-META", f"{name}.schema.json", "$schema must be 2020-12")

mutations.name: unknown YAML is E-KIND
mutations.old: code, msg = ("E-KIND" if d.kind == "unknown" else "E-LOAD"), d.load_error

mutations.name: unparsable file is E-LOAD
mutations.old: code, msg = ("E-KIND" if d.kind == "unknown" else "E-LOAD"), d.load_error

mutations.name: example kind needs a schema
mutations.old: R.error("E-KIND", d.path, f"no schema named {d.kind!r}")

mutations.name: JCS vectors vs canonical.py
mutations.old: R.check(jcs(value) == expected, "E-JCS", "canonical.py", f"RFC 8785 vector mismatch: {jcs(value)!r} != {expected!r}")

mutations.name: JCS vectors vs rfc8785
mutations.old: R.check(rfc8785.dumps(value) == expected, "E-JCS", "rfc8785", "reference library disagrees with the RFC 8785 vector")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-JCS", "rfc8785", "reference library disagrees with the RFC 8785 vector")

mutations.name: document not canonicalisable
mutations.old: R.error("E-JCS", d.path, f"[{i}] not canonicalisable: {exc}")

mutations.name: canonical.jcs agrees with rfc8785
mutations.old: R.check(mine == ref, "E-JCS", d.path, f"[{i}] canonical.jcs differs from rfc8785 0.1.4")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-JCS", d.path, f"[{i}] canonical.jcs differs from rfc8785 0.1.4")

mutations.name: registry deny-list equals TOOLKIT_DENYLIST
mutations.old: R.check(denied_in_registry == set(safety.TOOLKIT_DENYLIST), "E-TOOLS-DENYLIST", "tools.yaml",

mutations.name: calibration model family/lineage
mutations.old: R.check(reg is not None and reg.get("family") == m.get("family") and reg.get("lineage") == m.get("lineage"), "E-CAL-MODEL", w,

mutations.name: weight row model in config.models
mutations.old: R.check(mk in keys, "E-CAL-MODEL", f"{w} weights {mk}/{row.get('cwe_bucket')}", "model not in config.models")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-CAL-MODEL", f"{w} weights {mk}/{row.get('cwe_bucket')}", "model not in config.models")

mutations.name: only arm 5 exploratory
mutations.old: R.check(arm.get("exploratory") is (arm.get("arm") == "5"), "E-CAL-ARMS", w, f"arm {arm.get('arm')}: only arm 5 is exploratory")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-CAL-ARMS", w, f"arm {arm.get('arm')}: only arm 5 is exploratory")

mutations.name: arm model keys known
mutations.old: R.check(set(arm.get("model_keys", [])) <= set(keys), "E-CAL-ARMS", w, f"arm {arm.get('arm')}: unknown model keys")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-CAL-ARMS", w, f"arm {arm.get('arm')}: unknown model keys")

mutations.name: result exploratory arm 5
mutations.old: R.check((res.get("exploratory") or {}).get("arm") == "5", "E-CAL-ARMS", w, "result.exploratory.arm must be 5")

mutations.name: M-11 flag
mutations.old: R.check(row.get("flag") == want, "E-CAL-M11", w, f"M-11 {row.get('model_key')}: flag must be {want}")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-CAL-M11", w, f"M-11 {row.get('model_key')}: flag must be {want}")

mutations.name: valid_for_model_keys in config.models
mutations.old: R.check(set(res.get("valid_for_model_keys", [])) <= set(keys), "E-CAL-MODEL", w, "valid_for_model_keys not in config.models")

mutations.name: kappa acceptance
mutations.old: R.check(x.get("accepted") is (x.get("kappa", 0) >= (cfg.get("annotation") or {}).get("kappa_min", 0)), "E-CAL-KAPPA", w,

mutations.name: duplicate license components
mutations.old: R.check(len(comps) == len(c.licenses.get("components", [])), "E-LIC-DUP", "licenses.yaml", "duplicate components")

mutations.name: tool license_ref listed
mutations.old: R.check(spec.get("license_ref") in comps, "E-LIC-MISSING", "tools.yaml", f"{t}: license_ref {spec.get('license_ref')!r} not in licenses.yaml")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-LIC-MISSING", "tools.yaml", f"{t}: license_ref {spec.get('license_ref')!r} not in licenses.yaml")

mutations.name: legal gate needs milestone
mutations.old: R.check(x.get("gate_milestone") is not None, "E-LIC-GATE", "licenses.yaml", f"{x.get('component')}: 法務閘門 needs a gate_milestone")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-LIC-GATE", "licenses.yaml", f"{x.get('component')}: 法務閘門 needs a gate_milestone")

mutations.name: requirements.txt present
mutations.old: if R.check(req is not None, "E-REQ", "requirements.txt", "requirements.txt missing"):

mutations.name: requirements listed as validator deps
mutations.old: R.check(n in lic and str(lic[n].get("usage", "")).startswith("validator"), "E-LIC-MISSING", "requirements.txt",

mutations.name: rfc8785 pinned
mutations.old: R.check("rfc8785==0.1.4" in req.replace(" ", ""), "E-REQ", "requirements.txt", "rfc8785 must be pinned to 0.1.4")

mutations.name: tool:mode id
mutations.old: R.check(safety.ADAPTER_RE.match(f"{t}:{m}") is not None, "E-TOOLS-ID", "tools.yaml", f"{t}:{m} is not a D13 tool:mode id")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-TOOLS-ID", "tools.yaml", f"{t}:{m} is not a D13 tool:mode id")

mutations.name: executable mode base_class
mutations.old: R.check(ms.get("base_class") in safety.ORDER, "E-TOOLS-CLASS", "tools.yaml", f"{t}:{m}: executable mode needs a base_class")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-TOOLS-CLASS", "tools.yaml", f"{t}:{m}: executable mode needs a base_class")

mutations.name: B4 modes in Z3
mutations.old: R.check(not ms.get("b4_executable") or spec.get("zone") == "Z3", "E-TOOLS-ZONE", "tools.yaml", f"{t}:{m}: B4 modes run in Z3")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-TOOLS-ZONE", "tools.yaml", f"{t}:{m}: B4 modes run in Z3")

mutations.name: report run exists
mutations.old: if not R.check(run is not None, "E-REPORT", w, "run not found"):
mutations.new: if not R.check(True, "E-REPORT", w, "run not found"):

mutations.name: report advisory iff Lane A
mutations.old: R.check(rm.get("advisory") is (run.get("run_kind") == "lane_a"), "E-REPORT", w, "advisory iff Lane A")

mutations.name: report verdict_counts
mutations.old: R.check(rm.get("verdict_counts") == counts, "E-REPORT", w, f"verdict_counts must be {counts} (latest verdict per cluster)")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-REPORT", w, f"verdict_counts must be {counts} (latest verdict per cluster)")

mutations.name: selftest NOT_RUN has no result
mutations.old: R.check(i.get("passed") is None and i.get("value") is None and i.get("runs") == 0, "E-SELFTEST", w, f"{i.get('item')}: NOT_RUN has no result")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-SELFTEST", w, f"{i.get('item')}: NOT_RUN has no result")

mutations.name: selftest RUN needs runs
mutations.old: R.check(i.get("passed") is not None and i.get("runs", 0) >= 1, "E-SELFTEST", w, f"{i.get('item')}: RUN needs runs and passed")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-SELFTEST", w, f"{i.get('item')}: RUN needs runs and passed")

mutations.name: selftest overall_passed
mutations.old: R.check(st.get("overall_passed") is (bool(ran) and all(i.get("passed") for i in ran)), "E-SELFTEST", w, "overall_passed must be all RUN items passed")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-SELFTEST", w, "overall_passed must be all RUN items passed")

mutations.name: checkpoint run exists
mutations.old: if R.check(run is not None, "E-CHECKPOINT", d.path, "run not found"):

mutations.name: checkpoint status/thread
mutations.old: R.check(d.data.get("run_status") == run.get("status") and d.data.get("thread_id") == run.get("run_id"), "E-CHECKPOINT", d.path,

mutations.name: checkpoint encrypted
mutations.old: R.check(d.data.get("encrypted") is True or run.get("data_class") == "P", "E-CHECKPOINT", d.path, "C-class checkpoints must be encrypted")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-CHECKPOINT", d.path, "C-class checkpoints must be encrypted")
